questions.prints: Does `diff` change what prints on the worksheet paper, in the exported .docx or the printed PDF (text, layout, spacing, numbering, marks, diagrams)?
questions.ui: Does `diff` add or change something a teacher sees on screen in the app (a control, label, layout, style, dialog or interaction)?
questions.stored: Does `diff` change the shape or meaning of saved document data (Worksheet fields, migrations, or how documents and the document index are written to storage)?
questions.teacher: Would a teacher using the app notice `diff`, as a new feature, a changed behaviour or a bug fix, rather than a refactor, test, comment or developer tooling?
questions.cover: Does `diff` change how the mock-exam cover page is laid out, rendered or exported?
questions.lq: Does `diff` change the long-question answer booklet (QAB): its dotted answer lines, page furniture, fill-to-page line count or 10pt sizing?

checks.why: source or lint config changed; the hook reduces the known baseline problems to one line
stored data may change: a failure means a published document broke; migrate, never regenerate the corpus
UI is verified in a browser, not by reading source
the .docx is the load-bearing output: open it and check it is leak-free; UI work must prove it still exports
the cover's three backends (preview, .docx, print PDF) must agree
the booklet's three backends and page count must agree
desktop work is verified in the shell
desktop-adjacent or build config changed; postbuild checks no Tauri in the web bundle
every feature or fix adds a line for teachers in the same commit, then npm run changelog
CHANGELOG.md changed; CI fails on the stale generated copy
